definitionZh: 嵌入式启动 CSS 属性定义了元素的逻辑嵌入式启动嵌入式,它根据元素的写法模式,方向性,以及文本方向,映射到物理嵌入式.
sourceDefinition: The padding-inline-start CSS property defines the logical inline start padding of an element, which maps to a physical padding depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation.
